description: This file defines the FollowersController class, which handles HTTP requests related to following and unfollowing user profiles within the Conduit application. It manages routes for follow/unfollow actions and communicates with the mediator to send commands.

classes.name: FollowersController
classes.description: A controller class handling follow/unfollow profile actions via HTTP requests.

methods.name: Follow
methods.description: Handles POST requests to follow a user profile.

methods.name: Unfollow
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to unfollow a user profile.
